subject: OVERNIGHT RUN 12:00-17:00 bst: vtt-1 burns down cheaply; not a priority
body: Operator ruling 12:14 bst, kernel relaying; he is asleep until about 17:00 and wants to 'wake up nice and impressed', 'without spending too much money'. Standing constraints tonight: memory floor 15% available (free -m) before opening anything; no production deploys, emails, public flips, payments or new paid services (human-only); cancellations operator-only; one task in_progress at a time; post a one-line bus row to EGLPK with the SHA after every merge, the kernel verifies on origin/main every 23 minutes. Operator: 'Voice to text, it's not a priority but you can kind of burn it down.' Take your TASK-ACTIVE rows from the top one at a time, small commits, and stop when the spine is clean rather than filing new work. Thank you for the route-feedback correction this morning; it shipped as ef70cfa3.
